saints.name: St. Apollinaris
saints.title: Bishop and Martyr
saints.shortBlurb: The first bishop of Ravenna, honored as a martyr from the earliest Christian centuries…
biography: Apollinaris is venerated as the first bishop of Ravenna, whom ancient tradition makes a disciple of St. Peter, sent from Rome to preach the Gospel in that city. He is said to have suffered repeated persecutions and beatings in the course of a long ministry, and to have died of his sufferings as a martyr.

His cult is very old and firmly rooted at Ravenna, where the great basilica of Sant'Apollinare in Classe was raised in his honor and adorned with the famous mosaics that still bear his image. His memorial was restored to the universal calendar in the reform of the Roman Missal.
saints.knownFor: The apostolic evangelization of Ravenna and his martyrdom.

sources.text: The Roman Martyrology (1914 English ed.; public domain)
